CONDITION GRADES

Know exactly what arrives.

Every part is graded on one of three conditions. All three carry the same 2-year DATUM warranty.

WHICH GRADE FITS
  • NS
    New builds & critical sparesFactory sealed, ready for commissioning and shelf stock.
  • OB
    Budget-conscious buildsUnused hardware at a lower price than sealed stock.
  • UT
    Legacy & line-down repairsDiscontinued parts, powered up and tested before they ship.
Included
